name: Mori
source: Original doodle entered in the shipped drawing editor

assessment.features: A simple, stylized round creature with a white body outlined in dark green. It has two small, angular arms and two short, blocky legs. On top of its head is a thin green stem with two diamond-shaped green leaves. The face consists of two vertical dark green lines for eyes, a small 'v' shaped dark green mouth, and two horizontal pink oval blush marks on the cheeks.

personality.appearance: A simple, stylized round creature with a white body outlined in dark green. It has two small, angular arms and two short, blocky legs. On top of its head is a thin green stem with two diamond-shaped green leaves. The face consists of two vertical dark green lines for eyes, a small 'v' shaped dark green mouth, and two horizontal pink oval blush marks on the cheeks.

summary.en: Inspired by the name Mori (forest) and its sprout-like head, this character is a gentle observer of nature who moves slowly to avoid startling nearby insects.
summary.ko: 숲을 뜻하는 이름과 머리의 새싹에서 영감을 받아, 주변 곤충들이 놀라지 않게 천천히 움직이며 자연을 관찰하는 다정한 성격입니다.

voice.en: Soft-spoken and rhythmic, like a light breeze through leaves.
voice.ko: 나뭇잎 사이로 부는 산들바람처럼 부드럽고 리듬감 있게 말합니다.

habit.en: Gently tilts its head to the side to balance its two diamond-shaped leaves when thinking.
habit.ko: 생각에 잠길 때면 다이아몬드 모양의 잎사귀 두 개가 균형을 잡도록 고개를 옆으로 살짝 기울입니다.
